oracle_output.summary: This PR adds a commitment hash display with copy functionality, renames UI labels, replaces audit details scroll with a Bloomberg-style right-side drawer, adds delta-q breakdown to LMSR widget, includes a status strip, and adds 'Simulated feed' tooltips throughout the VRF terminal interface.
key_claims: Added commitment hash pill with copy button functionality using constant COMMITMENT_HASH
Renamed 'Entropy Utilisation' to 'VRF Events (24h)' and 'Entropy Pricing' to 'Risk Fee Jitter'
Replaced audit details scroll behavior with a right-side drawer that opens when clicking audit details buttons
Added AuditDrawerData interface and drawerEntry state to manage drawer functionality
Added delta-q share breakdown line to LMSR demo widget showing price change, shares, and cost
Added status strip above audit trail showing system status and VRF metrics
Added 'Simulated feed' tooltips to various data elements including request IDs and block transactions
Added escape key handler to close drawer
Added hashCopied state with 2-second timeout for copy feedback
Removed scroll-to-audit functionality in favor of drawer opening
